sections.heading: What Mokova3D is about
sections.body: Mokova3D is a Delhi & NCR based creative 3D printing brand focused on useful objects, home décor, gifts, collectibles, lighting and custom-made pieces. The goal is simple: take an idea, reference or design and turn it into a physical object.

sections.heading: What we make
sections.body: Our work includes ready-to-enquire products, decorative figures, small gifts, keychain-style pieces, shadow lamps, miniatures, prototypes, functional prints and custom figurines. Availability, size, colour and finish can vary by design.

sections.heading: Custom 3D printing
sections.body: Already have a photo, sketch, STL, product link or rough idea? Send it to Mokova. We can discuss the size, quantity, material/colour options, feasibility and an estimated price before production.

sections.heading: How we work
sections.body: We keep the process direct: share your requirement, confirm the details and quote, then the piece is printed and prepared for pickup or delivery. For custom work, production starts after the agreed specifications are confirmed.

sections.heading: Why customers choose Mokova
sections.body: Direct WhatsApp support, flexible custom enquiries, small-batch creative work and a catalogue that can grow with new designs. If something is not listed, it is still worth asking.

contact.title: Contact Mokova
contact.intro: Tell us what you want to make, buy or customise.

sections.heading: Product enquiries
sections.body: Send the product name, quantity and delivery location. We will confirm current availability, final price and delivery details on WhatsApp.

sections.heading: Custom 3D printing
sections.body: For custom work, share a photo, sketch, STL/model, reference link or a short description. Include the approximate size, quantity and intended use if known.

sections.heading: Bulk & gifting orders
sections.body: Multiple pieces, return gifts, event requirements and small-batch gifting enquiries can be discussed. Tell us the quantity and preferred timeline.

sections.heading: What to include
sections.body: The more useful the reference, the faster we can help. Useful details include size, colour, quantity, delivery pincode, budget range and any deadline.

shipping.title: Shipping & Delivery
shipping.intro: Delivery details can vary by product and destination.

sections.heading: Delivery area
sections.body: Mokova currently focuses on Delhi & NCR enquiries. If you are outside the area, ask on WhatsApp and we can confirm whether delivery is possible for your location.

sections.heading: Before dispatch
sections.body: For each order, confirm the product, quantity, colour/customisation, final price and delivery location before payment or production.

sections.heading: Delivery timelines
sections.body: Timelines depend on whether the item is ready, needs printing, requires customisation and the destination. Custom or bulk orders may need additional production time.

sections.heading: Delivery charges
sections.body: Delivery charges can vary by destination, package size and order quantity. Confirm the final delivered amount with Mokova before placing the order.

sections.heading: Custom orders
sections.body: Custom prints are produced according to the approved specifications. Please review the agreed size, design and colour details carefully before production starts.

returns.title: Returns
returns.intro: Return eligibility depends on the product and its condition.

sections.heading: Before ordering
sections.body: Please confirm the product, size, colour, quantity, customisation and delivery details before confirming an order.

sections.heading: Ready-made products
sections.body: If a ready-made product arrives damaged or there is a clear issue with the item received, contact Mokova promptly with photos/videos so the issue can be reviewed.

sections.heading: Custom-made products
sections.body: Custom products are made to the specifications agreed before production. Changes requested after production has started may not be possible.

sections.heading: Wrong or damaged item
sections.body: If you receive the wrong item or a damaged package, contact Mokova as soon as possible and keep the packaging and relevant photos for review.

sections.heading: Refunds & replacements
sections.body: Any refund, replacement or correction is handled after the issue and order details are reviewed. The final resolution depends on the circumstances of the order.

sections.heading: Information you share
sections.body: You may share your name, phone number, email, delivery details, product requirements, reference images or other information when contacting Mokova.

sections.heading: How information is used
sections.body: Information is used to respond to enquiries, discuss products or custom work, coordinate delivery and provide customer support.

sections.heading: WhatsApp communication
sections.body: When you choose a WhatsApp enquiry button, your message is handled through WhatsApp. Please review WhatsApp’s own privacy practices for information handled by that service.

sections.heading: No unnecessary data collection
sections.body: The website is designed to keep the enquiry flow simple. Do not send passwords, OTPs, payment PINs or other sensitive credentials in an enquiry.

sections.heading: Questions
sections.body: For questions about information shared with Mokova, contact us through the website WhatsApp channel.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.intro: Please review these general terms before ordering.

sections.heading: Product information
sections.body: 3D printed products can have small variations in finish, colour, texture and dimensions. Product images are intended to show the design and may not represent every possible finish.

sections.heading: Prices & availability
sections.body: Prices and availability can change. A product marked “Ask on WhatsApp” requires a current quote before ordering.

sections.heading: Custom orders
sections.body: Custom work is based on the reference and specifications agreed with the customer. Changes after approval may affect price or timeline.

sections.heading: Customer responsibility
sections.body: Customers should provide accurate size, colour, quantity, delivery and reference details and review the agreed specifications before production.

sections.heading: Communication
sections.body: WhatsApp is the primary enquiry channel for confirming current availability, quotes, customisation and delivery details.
